description: Welcome to The Hottest Here! 🔥 (Tracking urban heat anomalies). For the "Earth System Trend Detective" challenge, we’re building The Thermal Divide. Data centers dump massive waste heat while nearby neighborhoods struggle with winter energy bills. We’re using NASA data to track this heat and building a spatial routing dashboard to pipe it directly into municipal heating networks. We aren't just mapping a problem; we're building a tool to fight climate change and social inequity.
